criteria.title: EU/EEA legal entity control
criteria.description: Ensuring that ultimate decision-making authority resides within EU jurisdiction.

answers.label: Likely takeover by or transfer to a non-EU sovereign entity

Unlikely takeover by or transfer to a non-EU sovereign entity

answers.label: Governance bodies exist with EU actor participation

criteria.title: EU economic contribution

answers.label: Immediate shutdown of the service is expected

answers.label: Irreversible deletion neither guaranteed nor verifiable
